title: ABot-ER: Unified Embodied Reasoning through Agentic Data-Model Co-Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2610.18355v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce ABot Embodied Reasoning (ABot-ER), a unified embodied reasoning foundation model that breaks the tension between breadth and depth in embodied reasoning. Embodied intelligence demands the joint mastery of perception, planning, and execution, yet reconciling generality with specialization across this spectrum remains an open challenge. Within a single unified model, ABot-ER commands specialist-level depth across all three competencies, spanning spatial, scene, and temporal reasoning in perception; long-horizon action organization in planning; and point grounding and affordance in execution. The Agentic Data-Model Self-Evolution Engine continuously adapts data strategies to the model's evolving capability state. translated_title: ABot-ER：通过智能体式数据-模型协同进化实现统一具身推理
translated_abstract: 我们提出了ABot具身推理模型（ABot-ER），这是一个统一的具身推理基础模型，打破了具身推理中广度与深度之间的矛盾。具身智能要求感知、规划和执行三者的联合掌握，然而在这一能力谱系上如何协调通用性与专业性仍然是一个开放性挑战。在单一统一模型中，ABot-ER在全部三项能力上均达到了专家级深度：感知方面涵盖空间、场景和时间推理；规划方面涵盖长时程动作组织；执行方面涵盖点级定位（grounding）与可供性（affordance）。智能体式数据-模型自进化引擎能够根据模型不断演进的能力状态持续调整数据策略。任务条件自适应训练策略使用任务token在共享主干网络上激活轻量级低秩残差，将更新与异构输出格式分离，同时保留共享的具身知识……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: ABot-ER是一个统一的具身推理基础模型，通过智能体式数据-模型自进化引擎与任务条件自适应训练策略（任务token激活共享主干上的轻量级低秩残差），在单一模型内同时实现感知、规划、执行三方面专家级深度能力，打破了具身推理中广度与深度的权衡。
en_tdlr: ABot-ER is a unified embodied reasoning foundation model that achieves specialist-level depth across perception, planning, and execution within a single model—powered by an Agentic Data-Model Self-Evolution Engine and a Task-Conditioned Adaptive Training Strategy—thereby breaking the breadth-depth trade-off in embodied reasoning.
